item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We believe this plainly: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. We refuse to treat those lives as an acceptable cost of technological progress.

2. We cannot call it progress when we build power we cannot keep from being turned against people. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands. We demand prevention, not apologies.

3. We reject the race to build superintelligent AI. If it is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. We must act before that disaster—not wait until we are counting the dead.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We hold a clear position: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. We refuse to treat that loss of life as the price of innovation. We cannot separate the pursuit of unprecedented technological power from responsibility for its use. We demand enforceable limits on development, meaningful public oversight, and the political will to put human lives before commercial competition. We will not wait for mass casualties to make prevention a priority. We must stop this race before the choices being made today become a catastrophe we cannot undo.
